title: Inversion and Emphasis
description: Negative adverbial inversion (never, rarely, seldom) and locative fronting for dramatic cadence.

title: Cleft Sentences and Information Structure
description: It-clefts, wh-clefts, and thematic fronting to control information focus and communicative dynamism.

title: Participle Clauses and Adverbials
description: Form economical participle adjuncts expressing time, reason, condition, and result.

title: Subjunctive and Unreal Past
description: Mandative and formulaic subjunctive (be that as it may), plus unreal past with high time and as though.

title: Advanced Conditionals and Inversion
description: Inverted conditionals without if (had we known, should you need), mixed conditions, and concessives.

title: Advanced Passive and Impersonal Structures
description: Impersonal reporting passive (it is alleged that, he is believed to have left) and passive with sensory verbs.

title: Nuanced Modal and Semi-Modal Usages
description: Needn't have vs didn't need to, dare, epistemic certainty, and tentative hedging stances.

title: Complex Verb Complementation
description: Ergative/labile verbs, complex predicate complements, and cognate prepositional objects.

title: Noun Phrase Complexity and Determiners
description: Compound noun modifiers, nominal concord (committee has/have), and partitive quantifiers.

title: Reduced Relative and Nominal Clauses
description: Nominal relative clauses with whatever/whoever and post-nominal participle reductions.

title: Adverbials, Positioning, and Discourse Markers
description: Stance and comment adverbials (undeniably, frankly, supposedly) and discourse flow transitions.

title: Advanced Ellipsis and Substitution
description: Clause reduction, noun phrase ellipsis, pseudogapping, and concise stylistic omissions.

title: Complex Prepositions and Particles
description: Multi-word prepositions (in lieu of, by virtue of, in light of) and particle shifts.

title: Register and Stylistic Variation
description: Formal academic nominalization, rhetorical conventions, and sophisticated communicative registers.
